text.p: Quintiles Transnational Corp said on Wednesday that it had acquired privately held Butler Communications Inc and its affiliated companies in exchange for roughly 214,000 shares of Quintiles stock.
The transaction, which will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, also calls for Quintiles to assume about $2.8 million in existing Butler Clinical Recruitment debt, Quintiles said.
Quintiles added that it expects the transaction to be neutral or slightly accretive to its 1997 earnings per share.

"Butler facilitates rapid recruitment of patients, which is crucial to meeting the competitive needs of our customers and getting drugs to market faster," said Quintiles chief executive Dennis Gillings.
Quintiles Transnational Corp provides contract research, sales and marketing services to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device industries.
Butler Clinical Recruitment specializes in communication programs to accelerate the recruitment of patients for clincial trials.
